description: National totals (India, all states/UTs) for cases registered, chargesheeted, convicted, conviction rate, and cases pending trial, under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act, 2018-2022. Transcribed directly from a Rajya Sabha Unstarred Question reply (Ministry of Home Affairs), which itself sources NCRB's 'Crime in India' publication. This is a DIFFERENT official compilation from the district-level crime CSVs used in scripts/crime/clean.py (that pipeline sums all crime-head columns per district; this one is MHA's own state-wise PoA-Act-specific total) -- the two are conceptually distinct metrics, though they cross-validate closely for overlapping years (national SC 2018: 42,539 here vs 42,793 in the other pipeline, within 0.6%).

source_document.title: Rajya Sabha Unstarred Question No. 301 -- Atrocities Against Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
source_document.answered_by: Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs (Shri Bandi Sanjay Kumar)
source_document.table_location: Annexure-I (Scheduled Castes), Annexure-II (Scheduled Tribes), 'TOTAL (ALL INDIA)' row of each year's table
source_document.underlying_source: NCRB 'Crime in India' publication, per the reply's own text ('the latest published report pertains to the year 2022')

field_definitions.cases_registered: CR -- new cases registered that year
field_definitions.cases_chargesheeted: CCS -- cases where police filed a chargesheet
field_definitions.conviction_rate_pct: CVR -- conviction rate percentage as stated in the source (methodology not detailed in the reply; treated as reported, not recomputed)
field_definitions.cases_pending_trial_year_end: CPTEY -- backlog of cases still in trial at year end (cumulative, not just that year's cases)
